name: tag
title: Tag
description: A label the user applied and can remove: a chip with an optional categorical colour swatch and a remove button; TagGroup wraps them in a row.
usage: Use Tag for labels a user adds and removes (a saved query's labels, applied filters). onRemove adds a remove button; swatch (1 to 8) adds a colour dot from the colour-blind-safe chart.cat roles so tags of different categories can be told apart. Put tags in a TagGroup (role="list") with role="listitem" on each. For a read-only status word use Badge; for choosing several values in a field use MultiSelect, which has its own chips.

props.name: children
props.description: The label; truncates when it does not fit (full text in title).

props.name: variant
props.description: neutral for labels, accent for an active filter; warning is the orange status tone (color.status.warning.*).

props.name: size
props.description: sm (size.control.xs) in dense lists, md (size.control.sm) in forms.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Shows a remove button that calls it.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the remove button; default "Remove <label>".

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the tag and disables its remove button.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render another element.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The chip; data-slot="tag", data-variant, data-size, data-disabled.

slots.name: group
slots.description: TagGroup, role="list", a wrapping row; data-slot="tag-group".

parts.name: TagGroup
parts.description: Tags in a wrapping row, role="list".

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over the remove button: color.interactive.hover.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on the remove button: an inset ring of ring.width in color.ring.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Dimmed to opacity.disabled; the remove button does nothing.

accessibility: The label is text; the remove button is a native <button> named "Remove <label>" (or removeLabel) in the tab order.
TagGroup is role="list"; give each Tag role="listitem" so screen readers count them.
The swatch is aria-hidden and the chart.cat palette is colour-blind safe; the label always carries the meaning.
When removing a tag moves focus, move it to the next tag's remove button or the group's input; the app owns that.
